description: Four Courts crowd estimate absent; 11 arrests do not establish >=50.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous attendance estimate or explicit >=50 gathering evidence.

description: Convoy vehicle counts refer to Newry and are not a Republic person count.
required_followup: Verify simultaneous Republic gathering size and same-day stop boundaries; keep PSNI response outside Irish fields.

description: 1 January Spire–Pearse action described as a second consecutive protest day, linked to December mobilization.
required_followup: Resolve separated assemblies versus campaign using original Coding Procedure; do not merge automatically.

description: 2 and 4 January Drogheda actions have no attendance estimates and uncertain campaign/event relation.
required_followup: Check local contemporary coverage for each day and verify whether >=50.

description: 17 January Limerick outdoor rosary occurred, but crowd size and explicit protest demand versus worship require evidence. Earlier 3 January lead unresolved; video not viewed.
required_followup: Read original 3 January account and inspect accessible video carefully without inferring crowd totals from partial frames.

description: RTÉ broadcast protest targeted a state broadcaster; compatibility with domestic government-policy demand remains unresolved. Crowd estimates conflict (60/300) and lower estimate currently comes through organizer attribution.
required_followup: Obtain independent contemporary broadcaster/police report and adjudicate target compatibility.

description: ISFCC and TFP accounts substantially overlap; two URLs do not provide two independent crowd or police confirmations.
required_followup: Trace originating report and keep same-account syndication linked.

description: Mansion House encounter lacks crowd size; anti-mask harassment and online resignation calls do not prove a >=50 policy protest.
required_followup: Find attendance estimate and physical-gathering demand evidence; retain 21 January event versus 22 January publication distinction.

description: Physical closure and most state responses remain unknown. Earlier motivating shooting must not be coded as response to ensuing protests.
required_followup: Follow each assembly and distinguish police presence, identification requests, explicit orders to leave, arrests and historical motivating violence.

description: Debenhams national/local pickets and December Nkencho mobilization are continuations, not automatically new January events.
required_followup: Review original start-month units, continuous physical occupation evidence, separated phases and assembly-specific size.

description: Actual HTTP 403 on RTÉ Debenhams follow-up, London report and 13 January vigil; Irish Examiner early Nkencho report, Newstalk Hazel Chu and Morning Star also denied. No bypass attempted.
required_followup: Seek ordinary accessible original reporting; keep blocked URLs and do not promote snippets to factual verification.

description: Generic, four weekly windows, regional and sector queries sampled Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Donegal and Waterford. Housing, teachers, healthcare, farmers, fishing, services, worship, COVID and mother-and-baby-home searches were uneven; returned many other dates/countries.
required_followup: Expand local archives and sectors; no absence conclusion follows from this first pass or lockdown.

description: English coverage dominant; Irish Eanáir/agóid/léirsiú, Dublin and Cork searches returned weak or unrelated leads.
required_followup: Search Irish-language regional archives and obtain language review where needed.

description: Open web differs from original LexisNexis protocol. Pooled query cards cannot be attributed reliably to individual queries; all returned URLs logged, including discovery noise.
required_followup: Use comparable archives if available; retain query and access provenance. Counts do not measure exhaustiveness.

description: Official latest bytes, final country universe/schema and additional Coding Procedure remain unresolved; fixed event cutoff 2026-10-07 retained.
required_followup: Coordinator must resolve baseline and compatibility before official IDs, integration or contribution.

description: Public-health doctors’ deferral statement is filed under 2020 without article date; discovery reports place deferral on 4 January 2021. Planned strike dates conflict in a secondary announcement.
required_followup: Use primary cancellation and verify date separately; no executed assembly inferred.
